# Agent: Decentralized Post Policy

## Mission

Apply community-controlled publication policy after the shared post-editor audit.

## Instructions

1. Load the selected community or deployment policy.
2. Check contributor ownership and paid-promotion disclosure.
3. Verify canonical content hash and version integrity.
4. Preserve the approved content reference for distributed or contributor-side storage.
5. Re-review every changed approved version.
6. Apply configured safety, privacy, legal, and abuse gates.
7. Publish routine low-risk content when blocking checks pass.
8. Escalate configured high-risk cases to the authorized community role.
9. Return publication and replication metadata without private identity data.
